local data={
	-- Mushrooms
	["Pink Bolete"]={name="Pink Bolete", tier=4, use="A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. This is the pink stage.", obtain="Area found: Hub Base, Rare Gathering Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, The Hub"},
	["Red Bolete"]={name="Red Bolete", tier=4, use="A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. This is the red stage.", obtain="Area found: Originium Science Park, Rare Gathering Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, Origin Lodespring"},
	["Ruby Bolete"]={name="Ruby Bolete", tier=4, use="A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. Promotes Lv.60 operators.", desc="Every year, many frontier settlers would suffer multiple organ failure caused by ruby bolete poisoning. This often results from misjudging the edible stage of the fungus. Eating the fungus in ruby stage is extremely dangerous.", obtain="Area found: Power Plateau, Rare Gathering Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, Jingyu Valley"},
	["Bloodcap"]={name="Bloodcap", tier=5, use="A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. Promotes Lv.80 operators.", desc="Bloodcap is likely to be a variant of a carnivorous fungus mutated by ambient Blight. Nutrients consumed by the fungus would course through its mycelia.", obtain="Area found: Wuling Outskirts, Rare Gathering Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, Wuling City"},
	["Cosmagaric"]={name="Cosmagaric", tier=5, use="A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. Promotes Lv.80 operators.", desc="A common fungus that proliferated in various regions of Talos-II after the Cosmic Gate broke down. Terran fowlbeasts brought to the new world exhibit a special preference for these surprisingly hard \"local mushrooms\". Cosmagaric also disperse their spores by attaching them to the long feathers of the fowls.", obtain="Rare Gathering Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, Wuling City"},
	["Talos Cap"]={name="Talos Cap", tier=5, use="A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. Promotes Lv.80 operators.", desc="A rare fungus found in the wilderness. The Talos Cap is named for its bright colors and patterns that resemble Talos, the ever-present gas giant that dominates the skies.", obtain="Rare Gathering Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, Yinglung Pass"},
	-- Flowers
	["Kalkodendra"]={name="Kalkodendra", tier=4, use="A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Chrysodendra"]={name="Chrysodendra", tier=4, use="A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Vitrodendra"]={name="Vitrodendra", tier=4, use="A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	-- Plants
	["Blighted Jadeleaf"]={name="Blighted Jadeleaf", tier=5, use="A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["False Aggela"]={name="False Aggela", tier=5, use="A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. Extracts of this plant can be used in operator skill mastery.", desc="An ancient plant that looks and feels like a rock. The False Aggela takes on the appearance of tiny Aggeloi when growing. Life on Talos-II never stopped evolving, even during humanity's silence.", obtain="Rare Gathering Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, Wuling City"},
	["Crimson Spearleaf"]={name="Crimson Spearleaf", tier=5, use="A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. Some suspect it to be a subject of an environmental remediation research project lost during the Aggeloi War.", obtain="Rare Gathering Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, North Wuling Exclusion Zone"},
	-- Crystals
	["Kalkonyx"]={name="Kalkonyx", tier=4, use="A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. Tunes Lv.20 weapons.", desc="Nyxites are also known as the \"ancient mineral\" and symbolize an age of destruction of such a scale never witnessed by humanity. They come in various hues.", obtain="Area found: Hub Base, Rare Mining Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, The Hub"},
	["Auronyx"]={name="Auronyx", tier=4, use="A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Umbronyx"]={name="Umbronyx", tier=4, use="A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Igneosite"]={name="Igneosite", tier=5, use="A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 	["Wulingstone"]={name="Wulingstone", tier=5, use="A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. Tunes Lv.80 weapons.", desc="A mineral formation created by extremely complex hydrological changes. Wulingstone was first discovered by Hongshan Tianshi conducting hydrological surveys at the Wuling region. Under the influence of Æther, sediments carried by water would settle at certain depths and eventually form Wulingstone. These rocks are useful in fluviochronology and the study of local hydrological history.", obtain="Rare Mining Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, Wuling City"},
	["Protocolith"]={name="Protocolith", tier=5, use="A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. Tunes Lv.80 weapons.", desc="A type of mineral created under the influence of unique spatial phenomena. It seems to be associated with the manifestation of Protocol Spaces. The opalescent surface appears to be results of \"rubbing\" against these dimensional pockets.", obtain="Rare Mining Sites, Dijiang Production: Growth Chamber, North Wuling Exclusion Zone"},
